title: How to Choose Your First Bespoke Suit
excerpt: Cloth weight, canvas construction, and lapel width all matter more than the label. Here's what to actually pay attention to.
content: Most first-time bespoke clients focus on color and forget the three things that actually determine how a suit wears: cloth weight, canvas construction, and cut.

In Bangkok's climate, cloth weight matters more than almost anywhere else. A heavy English wool that looks sharp in a showroom will feel unwearable by 11am on Sukhumvit Road. We steer most first-time clients toward tropical-weight wool blends in the 220–260 gram range.

Canvas construction, full canvas versus fused, is the difference between a jacket that molds to your body over time and one that holds a stiff, unchanging shape. It's not visible on a hanger, but it's the first thing you'll feel wearing it.
Book a measurement session before you fall in love with a specific cloth. Fit comes first.

title: Why Bespoke Takes 4–6 Days, Not 4–6 Weeks
excerpt: Bangkok's tailoring industry can move fast without cutting corners. Here's how a 4–6 day turnaround actually works.
content: Bangkok has one of the fastest bespoke tailoring turnarounds in the world, and it's a fair question to ask how that's possible without sacrificing quality.
The short answer: dedicated in-house cutting and stitching teams working across a single commission at a time, rather than batching multiple client orders through one artisan sequentially.

The tradeoff is availability, not quality. During high season (wedding months, year-end), turnaround can extend past our usual 4–6 day window, which is why we recommend booking your fitting a little earlier than you think you need to.

title: Caring for Your Bespoke Garments in Bangkok's Climate
excerpt: Humidity is the real enemy of a well-built suit. A few habits that add years to a bespoke garment's life.
content: Bangkok humidity is harder on tailored garments than almost any other climate we've shipped to internationally.
Rotate suits rather than wearing the same one two days in a row. Natural fibers need 24 hours to fully release moisture and return to shape.
Use wooden hangers with a shaped shoulder, not wire. Wire hangers are the single fastest way to ruin a canvassed jacket's shoulder line.
Dry clean sparingly. Over-cleaning breaks down canvas structure faster than wear does.
